semiconductor_relevance: High — Dinghua Intelligent specializes in Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on digital transformation.
summary: Nanjing DigiHua Intelligent Systems Co., Ltd. provides Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Production Scheduling Systems (APS) for the semiconductor and discrete manufacturing sectors. With a strong emphasis on intelligent manufacturing and digitalization, the company supports over 260 semiconductor customers in achieving operational efficiency.

regional_presence.China: Dinghua Intelligent is based in mainland China and has established intelligent demonstration bases across the Asia-Pacific region.
